device.description: 12-bit 53 MSPS pipelined ADC with internal/external reference, out-of-range output and tri-state CMOS parallel outputs (3 V / 5 V output driver supply)
device.note: ads807.pdf (SBAS072A) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3-4 specifications (digital inputs VIH 2.4 V, straight offset binary, VDRV 3 V / 5 V outputs, 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns max, +VS 4.75-5.25 V), timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max for VDRV 2.7 V to 5 V, 6-clock latency), application section (OTR, VDRV, Tables II/III coding)

pages: p.2 (pinout, pin descriptions), p.3-4 (specs: digital I/O, coding, supplies), timing diagram (t2 12 ns, VDRV 2.7-5 V), application section (OTR, VDRV, coding tables)
notModeled: analog input and reference; the result is always the 0 V differential (mid-scale) code 800h, straight offset binary
FSSEL (2 Vpp / 3 Vpp full scale) and INT/EXT (reference select, internal 50 kOhm pull-up) are stored nowhere: they only change the analog range
OTR is driven as the first bit of each 13-bit data word (always 0: the 0 V input is in range)
pipeline latency of 6 clock cycles (the code is constant)
clock period / duty-cycle limits (18.87 ns to 100 us)
two supplies: +VS 4.75-5.25 V (analog core and CLK/OE inputs, VIH 2.4 V) and VDRV (output drivers, 2.7-5 V); vcc is the union 2.7-5.25 V and +VS is listed under analog so VDRV is the digital supply
3-state enable time (40 ns max) differs from the disable time (10 ns); tFloat uses the disable time
pin 24 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN
